loi.text: I built this roof from fir boughs. At eight o'clock... it started leaking.
Half past six. Early. Of course.
No thunder forecast. I keep checking, and I'd leave well before any storm.
Grandma's old mug. Forty summers of trips, and tonight it catches my leak.
My roof managed ninety minutes. Not perfect, but I'm staying dry.
